create_voxtralrealtime_processor: create a VoxtralRealtimeProcessor instance with a feature extractor and MistralCommonBackend tokenizer
encode_audio_streaming: encode audio chunks in streaming mode into token ids, attention masks, and mel spectrogram features
encode_audio_nonstreaming: encode a full audio input in non-streaming mode into token ids, attention masks, and mel spectrogram features
configure_processor_kwargs: configure VoxtralRealtimeProcessorKwargs with text and audio encoding defaults like padding and sampling rate
retrieve_audio_config_properties: retrieve audio encoder config properties like num_delay_tokens, audio_length_per_tok, and num_mel_frames_first_audio_chunk
